- Latest PDF proof ETA by EOD today?
- Rush production quote and fastest ETA (we're OK paying rush premium) — please break out material surcharge if you have eco-stock premiums.
- Envelope stock availability (we prefer 100% post-consumer recycled kraft; call out any substitutions).

Hi Sofia — thanks for the details. We can do this on rush with a realistic lead time of 6 business days after proof sign-off. A few items to flag up front:

1) Stock: 100% PCR kraft envelopes are currently limited; we can substitute a matte recycled kraft (80% PCR) with identical color and similar feel. If you require guaranteed 100% PCR we may hit a 3-5 day delay.

2) Die-cut sticker: we can produce the silver-ink sticker but metallic ink increases run time slightly. Recommend using a standard white-with-metallic-foil option to stay on the rush timeline.

3) Split shipments: yes — we can palletize 800 to the venue and courier 400 to SF office. Pallet deliveries to convention centers often require an ASN and receiving appointment (we'll need the venue's acceptance window).

Attached: greenprint_proof_v3.pdf (visual proof v3), rush_quote_lineitems.xlsx (line-item rush quote).

Please review the proof and confirm: (A) approve or request color tweak, (B) confirm substitution for kraft envelope if OK, and (C) confirm split ship addresses and receiving window. Once we have sign-off we'll generate a final PI and DocuSign for payment.

—Eli

Hi Laura — thanks for the notice. Confirming the following for Austin Convention Center (event inbound week):

- Pallet deliveries are accepted between 08:00–14:00 local time only; no pallet deliveries after 14:00.
- All pallet arrivals require a 48-hour ASN and a completed MSDS list for any materials with adhesives.
- If you plan a courier box (small parcel), that can be delivered to the exhibitor floor between 07:00–18:00 with a simple signature.
- We do not accept loose flyers or unsupported boxes — everything must be on pallet or boxed and labeled with booth # and contact.

Please ensure GreenPrint provides an ASN 48 hours before the pallet ETA and that the PI includes pallet dimensions and gross weight.

Best,
Venue Receiving Team
